```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sjPlot)
library(mgcv)
library(boot)
library(boot.pval)
library(parallel)
```

#Import areas and demographics for PFNs
```{r}
#Read in area data
areas_PNC <- read.csv("../../Inputs/PNC_summary_PFNs.csv") # n = 1482
colnames(areas_PNC) <- gsub("_soft_parcel_normed", "", colnames(areas_PNC))
areas_22q <- read.csv("../../Inputs/22q_summary_PFNs.csv") # n = 115
areas_22q <- areas_22q[areas_22q$session != 8971,] #Remove ses-008971 of sub-016095, since this subject has 2 sessions -> n = 114

#Pool 22q and PNC area data
areas_22q <- areas_22q[, -2] #remove session column
areas_all <- rbind(areas_PNC,areas_22q) # n = 1596

#merge pooled areas with matched and pooled demographic dataset
matched_demo <- read.csv("../../Results/Demographic_matching/matched_all_demo_QC_median_fd_r1x3.csv") # n = 215
matched_all <- merge(matched_demo,areas_all,by="subject") # n = 215

```

#Factorize 22q status and sex
```{r}
matched_all$stat_22q <- factor(matched_all$stat_22q)
matched_all$sex <- factor(matched_all$sex)
```

#Import areas and demographics for group atlas
```{r}
#Read in area data
areas_PNC_group <- read.csv("../../Inputs/PNC_summary_group.csv") # n = 1598
colnames(areas_PNC_group) <- gsub("_soft_parcel_normed", "", colnames(areas_PNC_group))
areas_22q_group <- read.csv("../../Inputs/22q_summary_group.csv") # n = 131
areas_22q_group <- areas_22q_group[areas_22q_group$session != 8971,] #Remove ses-008971 of sub-016095, since this subject has 2 sessions -> n = 130

#Pool 22q and PNC area data
areas_22q_group <- areas_22q_group[, -2] #remove session column
areas_all_group <- rbind(areas_PNC_group,areas_22q_group) # n = 1728

#merge pooled areas with matched and pooled demographic dataset
matched_all_group <- merge(matched_demo,areas_all_group,by="subject") # n = 215
```

#Factorize 22q status
```{r}
matched_all_group$stat_22q <- factor(matched_all_group$stat_22q)
matched_all_group$sex <- factor(matched_all_group$sex)
```

#Merge in PFN and Group Atlas areas
```{r}
# matched_all contains individualized PFN areas:
# PFN01, PFN02, ..., PFN17
#
# matched_all_group contains Group Atlas areas:
# PFN1, PFN2, ..., PFN17

# Select Group Atlas network areas
group_areas <- matched_all_group %>%
  select(
    subject,
    all_of(paste0("PFN", 1:17))
  )

# Rename Group Atlas columns
names(group_areas)[-1] <- paste0(
  "group_PFN",
  1:17
)

# Rename individualized PFN columns to match numbering convention
matched_all_boot <- matched_all

for (net in 1:17) {
  old_name <- sprintf("PFN%02d", net)
  new_name <- paste0("PFN", net)

  names(matched_all_boot)[
    names(matched_all_boot) == old_name
  ] <- new_name
}

# Merge by subject so PFN and Group Atlas areas are explicitly aligned
matched_22q_delta <- matched_all_boot %>%
  left_join(
    group_areas,
    by = "subject"
  )

# Factorize variables used as factors
matched_22q_delta$stat_22q <- factor(
  matched_22q_delta$stat_22q
)

matched_22q_delta$sex <- factor(
  matched_22q_delta$sex
)

matched_22q_delta$subclass <- factor(
  matched_22q_delta$subclass
)

# Confirm required PFN and Group Atlas columns are present
pfn_cols <- paste0("PFN", 1:17)
group_cols <- paste0("group_PFN", 1:17)

stopifnot(
  all(pfn_cols %in% names(matched_22q_delta)),
  all(group_cols %in% names(matched_22q_delta))
)

```

#Bootstrap (difference in 22q effect magnitude, 2-tailed)
```{r}
# Randomly sample matched subclasses with replacement.
# All participants within each sampled subclass are retained together.
# Fit the PFN GAM on that resampled matched dataset.
# Fit the corresponding Group Atlas GAM on the exact same resampled matched dataset.
# Extract the two raw log-area 22q coefficients: PFN + Group.
# Calculate the comparison statistic: |PFN beta| - |Group beta|.
# x 5000
#
# Positive delta = larger absolute 22q effect for PFN.
# Negative delta = larger absolute 22q effect for Group Atlas.

set.seed(1)
boot_n <- 5000
nets <- 1:17

make_boot_stat <- function(full_data, y_pfn, y_group) {

  function(cluster_data, indices) {

    # Resample matched subclasses rather than individual participants
    sampled_subclasses <- cluster_data$subclass[indices]

    # Reconstruct participant-level bootstrap sample
    d_list <- lapply(
      seq_along(sampled_subclasses),
      function(i) {

        original_subclass <- sampled_subclasses[i]

        tmp <- full_data[
          full_data$subclass == original_subclass,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]

        # Give each resampled copy of a subclass a unique ID.
        # This is necessary when the same original subclass is sampled
        # more than once in a bootstrap replicate.
        tmp$boot_subclass <- paste0("boot_", i)

        tmp
      }
    )

    d <- bind_rows(d_list)

    d$boot_subclass <- factor(
      d$boot_subclass
    )

    fit_pfn <- gam(
      log(d[[y_pfn]]) ~
        stat_22q +
        log(TC_area) +
        sex +
        euler +
        median_fd_combined +
        s(age, k = 4) +
        s(boot_subclass, bs = "re"),
      data = d,
      method = "REML"
    )

    fit_group <- gam(
      log(d[[y_group]]) ~
        stat_22q +
        log(TC_area) +
        sex +
        euler +
        median_fd_combined +
        s(age, k = 4) +
        s(boot_subclass, bs = "re"),
      data = d,
      method = "REML"
    )

    beta_pfn <- coef(fit_pfn)[["stat_22q1"]]
    beta_group <- coef(fit_group)[["stat_22q1"]]

    c(
      beta_pfn = beta_pfn,
      beta_group = beta_group,
      delta_magnitude =
        abs(beta_pfn) -
        abs(beta_group)
    )
  }
}

# Number of workers
# Leaving 1-2 logical cores free is usually sensible on a local machine
n_cores <- max(1, detectCores() - 2)

# Create Windows PSOCK cluster
cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)

# Load required packages on every worker
clusterEvalQ(cl, {
  library(mgcv)
  library(boot)
  library(dplyr)
})

# Reproducible independent RNG streams for workers
clusterSetRNGStream(cl, iseed = 1)

boot_results <- vector("list", length(nets))
names(boot_results) <- paste0("PFN", nets)

sample_sizes <- integer(length(nets))
subclass_sizes <- integer(length(nets))

for (net in nets) {

  y_pfn <- paste0("PFN", net)
  y_group <- paste0("group_PFN", net)

  required_vars <- c(
    y_pfn,
    y_group,
    "stat_22q",
    "TC_area",
    "sex",
    "euler",
    "median_fd_combined",
    "age",
    "subclass"
  )

  d_net <- matched_22q_delta[
    ,
    required_vars,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # Identify participants with complete data for BOTH models
  d_net$row_valid <-
    complete.cases(d_net[, required_vars]) &
    d_net[[y_pfn]] > 0 &
    d_net[[y_group]] > 0 &
    d_net$TC_area > 0

  # Retain a matched subclass only if:
  # 1. every participant in that subclass has valid data
  # 2. both 22q-status groups are represented
  valid_subclasses <- d_net %>%
    group_by(subclass) %>%
    summarise(
      all_valid = all(row_valid),
      n_status = n_distinct(stat_22q),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      all_valid,
      n_status == 2
    ) %>%
    pull(subclass)

  d_net <- d_net %>%
    filter(
      subclass %in% valid_subclasses
    ) %>%
    select(-row_valid) %>%
    droplevels()

  sample_sizes[net] <- nrow(d_net)
  subclass_sizes[net] <- n_distinct(d_net$subclass)

  # boot() receives one row per matched subclass,
  # so resampling occurs at the matched-subclass level
  cluster_index <- data.frame(
    subclass = levels(d_net$subclass)
  )

  boot_results[[y_pfn]] <- boot(
    data = cluster_index,
    statistic = make_boot_stat(
      full_data = d_net,
      y_pfn = y_pfn,
      y_group = y_group
    ),
    R = boot_n,

    # Windows parallelization
    parallel = "snow",
    ncpus = n_cores,
    cl = cl
  )

  message(
    "Finished network ", net,
    " of ", length(nets),
    "; n = ", nrow(d_net),
    "; subclasses = ", n_distinct(d_net$subclass)
  )
}

# Shut down the workers when finished
stopCluster(cl)

```

#Compare delta of boostrapped PFN and Group Atlas (difference in 22q effect magnitude, 2-tailed)
```{r}
dout <- "../../Results/22q_Group_v_PFN_Models"
dir.create(dout)

# Bias-corrected and accelerated (BCa) bootstrap confidence intervals:
# - bias correction accounts for displacement of the bootstrap distribution relative to the observed estimate
# - acceleration accounts for changes in the standard error with the underlying data, using empirical influence information

# Bootstrap p-values are obtained by inversion of the corresponding BCa confidence-interval procedure.

results <- vector("list", length(nets))

for (net in nets) {

  pfn_name <- paste0("PFN", net)
  b <- boot_results[[pfn_name]]

  # observed statistics
  beta_pfn_obs   <- b$t0[1]
  beta_group_obs <- b$t0[2]
  delta_mag_obs  <- b$t0[3]

  n_boot_valid <- sum(
    apply(b$t, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x)))
  )

  prop_boot_valid <- n_boot_valid / boot_n

  # Bootstrap CI of difference in absolute 22q effect magnitude
  ci_delta_mag <- boot.ci(
    b,
    type = "bca",
    index = 3
  )$bca[4:5]

  # Bootstrap CIs of raw 22q betas
  ci_beta_pfn <- boot.ci(
    b,
    type = "bca",
    index = 1
  )$bca[4:5]

  ci_beta_group <- boot.ci(
    b,
    type = "bca",
    index = 2
  )$bca[4:5]

  # Bootstrap p-value from CI inversion
  #
  # H0: |beta_PFN| - |beta_Group| = 0
  # H1: |beta_PFN| - |beta_Group| != 0
  p_delta_mag <- boot.pval(
    b,
    type = "bca",
    theta_null = 0,
    alternative = "two.sided",
    index = 3
  )

  results[[net]] <- data.frame(
    PFN = pfn_name,

    n_participants = sample_sizes[net],
    n_subclasses = subclass_sizes[net],

    n_boot_valid = n_boot_valid,
    prop_boot_valid = prop_boot_valid,

    beta_pfn = beta_pfn_obs,
    beta_pfn_CI_low = ci_beta_pfn[1],
    beta_pfn_CI_high = ci_beta_pfn[2],

    beta_group = beta_group_obs,
    beta_group_CI_low = ci_beta_group[1],
    beta_group_CI_high = ci_beta_group[2],

    delta_magnitude = delta_mag_obs,
    delta_magnitude_CI_low = ci_delta_mag[1],
    delta_magnitude_CI_high = ci_delta_mag[2],
    p_delta_magnitude = p_delta_mag
  )
}

results <- bind_rows(results)

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    p_delta_magnitude_bonf =
      p.adjust(
        p_delta_magnitude,
        method = "bonferroni"
      )
  )

write_csv(
  results,
  paste0(
    dout,
    "/22q_Group_vs_PFN_raw_matched_boot_results_two_sided.csv"
  )
)
```
